Iconic EQ Heavy SMG (w/ Auto-Compensator, Folding Structure, Foregrip, Power Rebuild, SMG Cyclic Internals [SMG 4]). Holds 45 rounds. If used for Autofire more than twice in a row, it is Destroyed Beyond Repair. This weapon’s Folding Structure only renders the weapon Concealable while it is unloaded (Thus requiring a Reload Action to load it before it can be fired after unfolding). Can accept an additional Weapon Mod (2 Total).

Variant of: Guillotine
Category: V. Expensive
Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Class: Poor Quality Heavy SMG
Range: SMG
Pre-installed: Folding Structure, Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the V. Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
